C1265.title: Australian Man Charged over 'Evil Twin' WiFi Networks
C1265.summary: On June 28, 2024, the Australian Federal Police announced charges against a Western Australian man. Police alleged that he created 'evil twin' WiFi networks mimicking legitimate free services at airports in Perth, Melbourne, and Adelaide, on domestic flights, and elsewhere. Users were directed to fake pages requesting email or social-media credentials, and investigators found dozens of other people's credentials on his devices.
